name: Convert QBO Customer Into Karbon Customer
purpose: Pure mapper from a QuickBooks Online Customer JSON to a Karbon customer/party JSON: plucks currency, tax code, display and contact names, company name, balance, QBO id, parent/payment/sales-term refs and notes; uses DisplayName as OrganizationName when no company name and no person name; converts BillAddr and ShipAddr to Address entries (purpose billing/shipping, bill is primary), Mobile and PrimaryPhone to Phone entries, WebAddr to a web network address, and a comma-separated PrimaryEmailAddr to billing email network addresses. Returns the Karbon customer JSON.
open_question: Mapping oddities to carry over or fix: the address pluck maps "Line1" to AddressLine1 twice and never maps Line2 (AddressLine2) for either address (steps 39, 50); "Title" is mapped to both Salutation and Prefix; "Suffix" is mapped twice; the SalesTermRef pluck has its property name and target swapped ("SalesTermRef" -> "SalesTermRef.value", step 26); PrimaryPhone gets no label while Mobile is labelled "Mobile". Step 6 (an example QBO customer, with sample names/addresses) is disabled. Success value returned to the caller is the JSON at step 95.

purpose: Creates a Karbon customer from the converted QBO customer JSON inside a database transaction: starts the transaction, runs "_wip_Create Customer V3", then creates an External Link (type 5) from the new party role id to the QBO id, stores the party role id as the transaction result and ends the transaction with the error state.

open_question: ExternalLinkTypeId 5 is hard-coded as the QBO link type (step 39). The "_wip_Create Customer V3" and "Create External Link V2" scripts do the actual inserts (karbon_kontroller scripts 229 and 315, outside this share). If the create fails the link is skipped but the Result is still set at step 53 from DBTransactions::PartyRoleId (may be empty).

purpose: Updates an existing Karbon customer's QuickBooks-sourced data in a transaction: opens the customer through the transaction record by the party role id, then writes the QBO Balance and Notes to Customer, stores the party role id as result and ends the transaction.

purpose: Pushes a Karbon customer to QuickBooks Online inside a database transaction: validates that the JSON has FmId, opens the customer, party and (if present) the QBO external link (type 5) through the transaction record, reads the current QBO customer through LedgerLink "Read" when a QBO id exists, converts the customer with "Convert Karbon Customer into QBO Customer", sends it through LedgerLink "Send FMData To QBO", saves the result and ends the transaction. Missing customer, party or link record returns a validation error.

Called from karbon_LedgerLink script 633 as "Handle Customer Push to QBO" through a data-source reference ($$DataSourceControllerFile or file karbon_kontroller).
